captions.detailed: An immersion blender stand unit consisting of a tall, cream-colored cylindrical base housing mounted on a dark gray circular foot. Next to the main housing is a detachable blending wand arm that slides vertically along a prismatic joint. The arm features dark gray side guards, a blue button, and a thin metal shaft terminating in a blade guard cage that rotates on a revolute joint at the tip.
captions.instruction: Generate an immersion blender stand unit with a tall cylindrical base housing, a detachable blending wand arm that lifts out vertically from its dock via a prismatic joint, and a blade guard cage that rotates on a revolute joint at the tip of the wand.
captions.factory: Construct the main base housing using a cylinder for the body, a wider cylinder for the bottom stand, and a thin cylinder for the top cap. Model the blending wand arm using a vertical cylinder, rectangular prisms for the side guards, and a thin cylinder for the lower shaft. Create the blade guard cage at the tip by combining a small horizontal cylinder with thin rings and vertical bars, and define a prismatic joint between the base dock and the wand, plus a revolute joint between the wand tip and the cage.
